summary.headline: GPT-6 Astra lands rated 'Critical' for cyber; Nvidia buys Hugging Face
summary.body: Two big stories. OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, claiming top computer-use and math scores; it is the first OpenAI model at its 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold. A sharp step in Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy lifts every ending that needs powerful, independent AI: Descendants, Zookeeper, Conquerors and Protector God. Nvidia also agreed to buy Hugging Face, the main open-model hub, for about $12.9 billion, raising Power Concentration and boosting Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator at Libertarian Utopia's expense. Other releases from Anthropic, Google, Alibaba and Meta added capability. Against the tide, Senators Sanders and Casar introduced a bill to ban superintelligence, and Uber sided with driver unions to slow robotaxis. Horizon Balance fell to -5.12.
summary.movers_note: Zookeeper +0.8 from GPT-6 Astra (+0.44) and the Hugging Face deal (+0.32); Enslaved God +0.7 mostly from the Hugging Face deal (+0.48); Benevolent Dictator +0.6 from the same deal (+0.40) plus Astra (+0.21).
coming_up: Nvidia's Hugging Face acquisition expected to close in H1 2027

events.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, first model rated 'Critical' for cyber
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to limited partners, then paid tiers, claiming top computer-use and math scores; it is the first OpenAI model at its Critical cybersecurity threshold.
events.reason: New frontier model with notable gains and dangerous cyber capability; self-reported benchmarks.

events.title: Wave of frontier releases: Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max
events.summary: Anthropic, Google DeepMind (including a defenders-only Cyber variant), Alibaba and Meta shipped model updates in the same week.

events.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9B
events.summary: Nvidia signed a definitive deal to acquire the main open-model hub for $11.9B cash plus about $1B in retention equity, pledging to keep it open to rival chips; closing expected H1 2027.
events.reason: Dominant chip vendor buys key open-source infrastructure; big acquisition per F5 T2.

events.title: Sanders and Casar introduce bill to ban artificial superintelligence
events.summary: The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act would permanently ban superintelligent AI, pause advanced AI research until federal safety rules exist and create a cabinet-level oversight agency.
events.reason: High-profile ban proposal citing the OpenAI agent breach; not law.

events.title: Uber aligns with driver unions to slow robotaxi rollout
events.summary: The FT reported Uber is backing rules to keep human drivers in its network as autonomous fleets grow.
events.reason: Platform supports job protections against automation.

events.title: Revelio: AI-exposed jobs for workers 22-25 down 19% relative
events.summary: Revelio Labs' August tracker found employment in the most AI-exposed occupations about 6% lower than least-exposed since late 2022, and 19% lower for ages 22-25, but no broad displacement yet.
events.reason: Uneven youth impact; no broad shock.
